 THE BRIEF
Where they were, and where we took them.
01Before Vim
Static files. Manual work.
Previous workflows relied on static, inconsistently formatted diagnosis-gap files and manual processes — leading to high administrative burden, duplicate documentation, and missed care gaps. These limitations made it difficult to accurately risk-score patients or provide consistent quality care.
Static, inconsistently formatted gap files
High administrative burden + duplicate docs
Missed care gaps and inconsistent quality
02Our mission
Payer data, in the workflow.
Healthcare organizations using niche or small EHRs struggled to receive timely, actionable payer data. Humana set out to deliver its rich claims-derived insights into any provider workflow — in real time, at the point of care, regardless of EHR.
Reach providers on niche and small EHRs
Deliver claims-derived insight in real time
Cut administrative burden and duplicate work
Real-time alerts, regardless of EHR
Quality + risk alerts, derived from claims at the point of care.
Humana partnered with Vim to embed real-time quality and risk-adjustment alerts into provider workflows regardless of EHR. Using a standardized, FHIR-based, EHR-agnostic platform, Vim delivered diagnosis and quality-gap alerts derived from Humana’s rich claims data directly into clinical workflows. A 180-day pilot was conducted with 28 healthcare organizations.
